D: A basketball legend is pulled into a cartoon world to help Bugs Bunny and friends win a game against alien invaders.
P: Serve the drinks when Bugs fills the water bottle with Michael's secret stuff.
S: Baby carrots and cucumber sticks standing in cups over a herby ranch dip of sour cream, mayo, garlic, dill and chives.
Cheddar, cream cheese and spring onion rolled into balls, coated in smoked paprika and crushed corn chips so they look like basketballs, served with crackers.
the alien theme park on Moron Mountain
Cocktail franks wrapped in puff pastry strips, egg washed and baked at 200C for 15 minutes, with mustard and tomato sauce.
M: eating courtside at the Tune Squad game
Beef and pork meatballs baked at 200C for 15 minutes, simmered in tomato sauce, piled into long rolls with mozzarella and grilled until bubbly.
the halftime team talk in the locker room
Chicken tenderloins crumbed in panko and parmesan, baked at 220C for 15 minutes, with honey mustard and crunchy potato wedges.
W: the Monstars stealing the players' talent
Dark chocolate pudding in cups, topped with crushed chocolate biscuits and gummy worms crawling out like little monsters.
K: the bottle of plain water the Tune Squad thinks is magic
Ice-cold water in sports bottles, with orange slices and a splash of orange juice for the players who need a little boost.

s.how: Mix 200ml sour cream, 100ml mayonnaise, a crushed garlic clove and chopped dill and chives into a ranch dip. Spoon some into the bottom of small cups. Stand baby carrots and cucumber sticks upright in each cup so everyone gets their own serve.

Mix 200g grated cheddar, 250g cream cheese and 2 sliced spring onions. Roll into small balls and coat in smoked paprika mixed with crushed corn chips so they look like basketballs. Mark the lines with a chive or skewer and serve chilled with water crackers.

m.note: eating courtside at the Tune Squad game
m.how: Mix 250g beef mince and 250g pork mince with salt, roll into balls and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Simmer in crushed tomatoes for 15 minutes. Pile into long rolls, cover with mozzarella and grill until bubbly, then finish with torn basil.

w.note: the Monstars stealing the players' talent
w.how: Whisk 750ml milk, 3 tbsp cornflour and 80g sugar over heat until thick, then stir in 100g dark chocolate until smooth. Pour into cups and chill for 2 hours. Top with crushed chocolate biscuits and push in gummy worms so they look like they are crawling out.

d.note: the bottle of plain water the Tune Squad thinks is magic
d.how: Fill 4 sports bottles with ice and cold water. Add a good splash of orange juice to each and drop in a couple of orange slices. Shake them up and hand them out to the players who need a little something extra before the second half.
